blocks.md: Income reported on individual tax returns. The source behind long-run US Gini and top-share series.

- Covers the **top** of the distribution well, unlike surveys
- Available back to **1913–1917**, the longest US income series

- The unit is the **tax unit**, not the person or household
- Only covers **filers**; non-filers are missing at the bottom, especially early on
- Only **taxable income** concepts, which change with tax law
- Behavioural responses: when tax rates change, reported income can shift without real income changing

- [US Income Inequality Since 1917](note:us-income-inequality-since-1917)
